title: Language model-based data object extraction and visualization

source_provenance.note: Ephemeral request-token parameters are intentionally not persisted.

publicly_described_functional_concepts: using one or more language models to extract entities and relationships from unstructured text
classifying extracted triples against ontology object and link types
using normalization, vectorization, or similarity search to match classified triples to ontology definitions
creating ontology-backed data objects when extracted structure matches governed schema
collecting unmatched classified triples for review instead of silently changing the ontology
using interactive graph visualizations to review clusters of unmatched concepts and proposed ontology updates

scope_model.analysis_loop: ingest authorized text -> extract entity/relation triples -> classify to ontology concepts -> normalize/vectorize -> compare with current ontology -> materialize only governed matches -> queue unmatched structures -> visualize for human review -> approve or reject schema changes -> preserve provenance
building_patterns_relevant_to_independen: keep ontology definitions authoritative and external to model memory
treat LLM output as proposals rather than authoritative objects
separate matched-object creation from schema mutation
require review for new object/link types
record extraction model version, prompts/configuration, source record, match score, and reviewer decision
use reversible links from generated objects back to source passages

independent_claim_themes: LLM extraction of data triples from unstructured data
classification of triples against ontology definitions
similarity-based matching of classified triples to object/link types
interactive processing of unmatched triples to support ontology updates
claim_scope_signals.legal_scope_rule: Patent scope depends on controlling claims, prosecution history, legal status, and jurisdiction. This record is an engineering research abstraction only.

mandatory_safety_boundaries: no automatic ontology mutation from unmatched model output
